summary: This standard covers operators of marketplaces where securities, commodities and other financial instruments are traded, and of clearing services. Disclosure topics are promoting transparent and efficient capital markets, managing conflicts of interest, and business continuity and technology risks.

questions.text: What are (1) the number and (2) the average duration of (a) halts related to public release of information and (b) pauses related to volatility?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Minutes · Report a count and an average duration in minutes for each of the two types of trading interruption.

questions.text: What percentage of trades is generated from automated trading systems?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report a percentage (0 to 100) of trades generated by automated systems.

questions.text: What is your alert policy regarding the timing and nature of public release of information?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe when and how market participants are alerted to information releases and what the alerts contain.

questions.text: What policy do you have to encourage or require listed entities to publicly disclose environmental, social and governance (ESG) information?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the policy, whether disclosure is required or encouraged, and any guidance or standards supplied to listed entities.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses as a result of legal proceedings associated with fraud, insider trading, antitrust, anti-competitive behaviour, market manipulation, malpractice, or other related financial industry laws or regulations?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total monetary losses in your presentation currency for the reporting period, covering all legal proceedings of these kinds.

questions.text: What processes do you use for identifying and assessing conflicts of interest?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe how conflicts are identified, assessed, managed and escalated.

questions.text: What are (1) the number of significant market disruptions and (2) the duration of downtime?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Hours (h) · Report (1) a count and (2) total downtime in hours; state how you define a significant disruption.

questions.text: What are (1) the number of data breaches, (2) the percentage that were personal data breaches, and (3) the number of customers affected?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Percentage (%) · Report (1) a count, (2) a percentage and (3) a count of customers affected; answer each part separately.

questions.text: What efforts do you make to prevent technology errors, security breaches and market disruptions?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the controls, testing, resilience measures and incident response used.

questions.text: What is the average daily number of trades executed, by product or asset class?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the average daily number of trades for each product or asset class.

questions.text: What is the average daily volume traded, by product or asset class?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the average daily volume in your presentation currency for each product or asset class.
